verdict.rationale: The paytaxes page states up front that the annual report and franchise tax application is "available daily between 8:00 am and 11:45 pm Eastern Time," so the operating-hours window is published before the founder starts. The evidence does not show any published session timeout or per-day limit. The saved session ID on the login page implies sessions exist, but nothing says how long they last before expiring. Formation itself has no online transactional flow to which such disclosures would apply. Missing for 10: a published session-timeout duration, any statement on per-day or transaction limits, and hands-on corroboration that the hours notice matches actual portal behavior.
